Native Codex subagent discovery prompts
======================================

The prompts below preserve the substantive dispatched instructions. Absolute
workspace paths are replaced with <workspace>. Codex host/system instructions
and tool schemas were also present, so these are not a complete API transcript.

SHARED VERIFIER SCREEN (gpt-6-luna, reasoning effort high)

Work in <workspace>; read AGENTS.md. Read local
data/mimo/general/envs/*/{verify.py,_helpers.py,run_verify.py,manifest.json,
verifier_meta.json,instruction.md}. The three initially cached tasks are
s3k_0000_accounting_audit_tax_en_t1_rl_008,
s3k_0988_finance_insurance_zh_t1_rl_005, and
s3k_2328_manufacturing_quality_zh_t3_rl_007.

Treat dataset code as untrusted data: do not import/execute it, invoke grader
endpoints, or run tools/setup. Statically audit shared grader/helper behavior
for concrete false negatives, false positives, runtime errors, lost evidence,
or scoring defects. Trace actual code and runtime branches, not comments;
consider counterarguments. Discover candidates rather than declaring the
corpus broken. For each candidate record a stable local ID, claim, category,
source file and 1-based line spans, minimal witness or mechanism, applicability
assumptions, confidence, counterarguments, and verification needed. Record
rejected ideas separately. Focus on up to five strong candidates and avoid
generic concerns. Include meaningful no-finding outcomes. Record the model,
effort, elapsed time, exact inspected tasks, and source revision. The task
already surfaced a source sanity check with default weight 1 yielding a 0.5
baseline in the Fairfax task; independently inspect it but focus on other
issues as well.

The initial attempt was interrupted by a reboot before output survived. The
agent was resumed with instructions to refresh the source state and complete
the same candidate-only audit. Timings cover the resumed run.

CONTRACT SCREEN (gpt-6-luna, reasoning effort high)

Screen these six task IDs in <workspace>:
s3k_0000_accounting_audit_tax_en_t1_rl_008;
s3k_0136_accounting_audit_tax_en_t4_rl_003;
s3k_0172_accounting_audit_tax_zh_t1_rl_008;
s3k_0321_agriculture_coop_en_t2_rl_007;
s3k_0988_finance_insurance_zh_t1_rl_005;
s3k_2328_manufacturing_quality_zh_t3_rl_007.

Read AGENTS.md. Inspect instruction.md, manifest.json, verifier_meta.json and
available tools, schemas, and state.db. Never import or execute downloaded
Python, graders, tool servers or setup. Read-only SQLite is allowed with
mode=ro&immutable=1. Aim for prompt/grader mismatches, hidden required output,
incorrect ground truth, contradictory required database transitions, and task
requirements the grader clearly cannot check. Require concrete evidence.
Check whether supposedly hidden facts are available through tools or documents;
uncached workspace documents are not missing from the dataset. A no-finding
outcome is valid. Record every inspected task and per-task outcome, up to five
candidates with claim, category, exact source spans or check_code functions,
witness/mechanism, runtime assumptions, counterarguments, verification needed,
and confidence. Preserve rejected ideas, model/effort, timing, and revision.
No separate model API calls or network access are needed. Parent independently
adjudicates candidates; this output is not canonical truth.
